title: Dispatch: nnj6 level-1 class choices at creation (Sonnet 5.5, attempt 1)
description:
Implementation plan for parent eshyra-nnj6 (read `bd show eshyra-nnj6`: description, NOTES and acceptance criteria). Supervisor decisions below are made; STOP and record in notes if the code contradicts a premise.

WORKTREE/BRANCH: .worktrees/eshyra-nnj6.1 on branch eshyra-nnj6.1 (cut from origin/main f7326622). Deps already installed.

FILE BOUNDARY: a parallel task edits packages/core/src/config.ts, packages/core/src/model/evaluation.ts, packages/core/src/model/codexSdkMcpClient.ts, docs/codex-adapter.md, packages/core/test/config.test.ts, packages/core/test/codexSdkMcpClient.test.ts and packages/cli/test/cli.test.ts. Do NOT edit those. Put CLI evidence in characterWizard.test.ts / createCharacter.test.ts / characterCreationTranscript.test.ts.

CODE SURVEY
- Creation choices: packages/core/src/character/requiredChoices.ts (Level1RequiredChoiceKind, enumerateLevel1RequiredChoices -> collectClassChoices/ancestry/background). packages/core/src/character/characterDraft.ts mechanicalChoices() (~line 668; filters by MECHANICAL_CHOICE_KINDS; isChoiceSatisfied ~1294; draft `stale` mechanism; Dnd5eDraftSelections). finalizeCharacter.ts finalizeCharacterDraft (~419) -> buildFinalizedCharacter; CharacterSheet.featureChoices / subclass / spellcasting (CharacterSpellcasting buckets, validators ~131 and ~214). dnd5eRecipe.ts. CLI: packages/cli/src/characterWizard.ts + createCharacter.ts consume mechanicalChoices.
- Level-up machinery to REUSE (do not fork validation): levelUpFeatureChoices.ts (detectFeatureChoiceDescriptors / listDescriptor / resolveFeatureChoiceSelection / applyFeatureChoicesToSheet; option prerequisites), levelUpExpertise.ts (expertise record on featureChoices choiceId 'expertise', eligibility vs held skill proficiencies + thieves' tools), levelUpEngine.ts subclass application (SUBCLASS_FEATURE_SUFFIXES, subclassFeatureRefsForLevel ~1387, the apply that sets sheet.subclass ~1671), levelUpSpells.ts (applySpellPlacements, spellsUnion, class spellPreparation kinds: 'known' / 'prepared' / wizard spellbookStartingSpells).
- Pack facts: resolveClassLevel(class, 1).featureRefs gives level-1 features. feature:fighter:fighting-style, feature:ranger:favored-enemy (choice 'favored-enemy', 13 creature types), feature:ranger:natural-explorer (choice 'favored-terrain'), feature:rogue:expertise, level-1 subclass features feature:cleric:divine-domain, feature:sorcerer:sorcerous-origin, feature:warlock:otherworldly-patron. Subclass-granted level-1 choices exist (feature:draconic-bloodline:dragon-ancestor choice 'dragon-ancestor', 10 options) and must be collected once the subclass is chosen.

DECISIONS
1. Membership is pack-derived, not a hand list: every structured choice on a feature the character holds at level 1 (class level-1 features, plus the chosen subclass's level-1 features) that the level-up detectors can handle, plus the subclass pick itself when a level-1 feature is a subclass-selection feature. Anything the shared detectors cannot handle stays an explicit unstructured/blocking descriptor with a reason, never silently skipped. Add the needed Level1RequiredChoiceKind(s) (e.g. 'subclass', 'feature_choice', 'expertise') and include them in MECHANICAL_CHOICE_KINDS.
2. Validation and persistence go through the level-up helpers (refactor/export a shared entry point if needed, keeping level-up behaviour byte-identical; existing level-up tests must stay green). Persist picks on sheet.featureChoices exactly as level-up does ({featureRef, choiceId, optionIds, level: 1}); expertise in the ug4i.1 expertise record. Subclass persists on sheet.subclass {key, name} via the level-up subclass application so its level-1 features are granted.
3. Dependencies inside the draft: expertise options derive from the draft's chosen skill proficiencies (class + background + ancestry) and thieves' tools; subclass-granted choices depend on the subclass. When the upstream selection changes, mark the dependent selection stale using the existing stale mechanism.
4. Favored Enemy offers the 13 structured types only (humanoid-races alternative is eshyra-mdke). Do not invent options.
5. Structured spellcasting at creation: finalize writes sheet.spellcasting (cantrips always; 'known' casters -> known; wizard -> spellbook with its 6 starting spells, prepared only if the draft already collects a wizard preparation; 'prepared' casters (cleric/druid) -> prepared) and keeps sheet.spells as spellsUnion. Do NOT compute alwaysPrepared domain spells (that is eshyra-kn38).
6. No new progression-ledger event kind (see bead notes). Auditability = finalized sheet + its metadata.

EVIDENCE (real pack; concise, extend existing creation tests)
- Enumeration: a fighter draft lists the fighting-style choice; ranger lists favored enemy + favored terrain; rogue lists expertise (options = its chosen skills + thieves' tools); cleric/sorcerer/warlock list the subclass; a draconic-bloodline sorcerer then lists dragon-ancestor.
- Invalid picks rejected (option not in catalog; expertise in an unproficient skill); stale on skill change.
- Representative finalized characters (fighter, ranger, rogue, cleric, sorcerer, warlock, wizard) store and then applyLevelUp 1->2 succeeds without the legacy flat-spell classification path (sheet.spellcasting present before level-up) and level-up sees the subclass/fighting style (e.g. champion no-repeat later relies on it).
- CLI wizard presents and records at least one new choice end-to-end (existing CLI test style).

PROTOCOL: run `npm run verify:worktree` from the worktree root BEFORE committing (it rewrites files); commit on eshyra-nnj6.1; append a completion report with `bd update eshyra-nnj6.1 --append-notes` (changes, decisions, tests, verify result, follow-ups); file follow-ups with bd create; `bd close eshyra-nnj6.1`.
notes: Completed on branch eshyra-nnj6.1 (commit 78c5a881; not pushed). CHANGES: new creationClassChoices.ts derives level-1 class-feature choices from the pack (class L1 feature refs + chosen subclass L1 features) by running the shared level-up detectors (detectFeatureChoiceDescriptors, detectExpertiseDescriptors, resolveFeatureChoiceSelection, resolveExpertiseSelection, uncoveredChoiceDescriptors) as a level 0->1 pass over a view of the draft proficiencies; subclass pick via new levelUpSubclass.ts (SUBCLASS_FEATURE_SUFFIXES/resolveSubclassSelection/subclassFeatureRefsForLevel moved out of levelUpEngine, behaviour unchanged). New Level1RequiredChoiceKinds subclass/feature_choice/expertise (in MECHANICAL_CHOICE_KINDS); ids class.subclass and class.feature.<feature-slug>.<choiceId>; stored selections are option display names, mapped to pack ids on apply. mechanicalChoices appends them after ordinary choices and before duplicate-proficiency replacements, with refusal/application fields. Stale: an unsatisfied non-empty class-feature pick is added to draft.stale; picks whose choice no longer exists are pruned. Unsupported/uncovered pack choices become unstructured entries that block finalize with their reason (spell/cantrip categories belong to the spell flow, Channel Divinity is use-time). finalize writes subclass {key,name}, featureChoices {featureRef,choiceId,optionIds,level:1} (expertise included), and for casters structured spellcasting via effectiveSpellcasting classification (cantrips + known/spellbook/prepared bucket), sheet.spells = spellsUnion of canonical refs; no alwaysPrepared (eshyra-kn38). CLI wizard walks newly revealed dependent choices (re-reads list after each group) and shows unstructured ones without prompting. No ledger event kind added. DEVIATION: expertise eligibility follows sheet.skillProficiencies (background + class picks + replacements, plus class/background tools) because ancestry skills are not stored on the sheet; filed follow-up. TESTS: new core/test/creationClassChoices.test.ts (enumeration, invalid picks, stale, representative fighter/ranger/rogue/cleric/sorcerer/warlock/wizard finalize -> sqlite store -> applyLevelUp 1->2 with spellcasting present), CLI characterWizard.test.ts (fighting style, sorcerer subclass + dragon ancestor e2e) and createCharacter.test.ts finalize assertion. VERIFY: npm run verify:worktree passed (6135 passed, 3 skipped). FOLLOW-UPS filed: ancestry-granted skills not on sheet; creation spell step does not validate counts / wizard prep.
